summary: Frontend-only iteration59 executed. Required source regressions (issue54 + iteration57) passed, new helper regression passed, and live TV web checks found return-focus regressions across multiple source pages plus modal-back ordering issue. Direct hash radio/search routing now resolves.

ui_bugs.issue: GenreList -> RadioPlaying -> Backspace returns to GenreList route, but focused station differs from originally opened station ID.
Search result -> RadioPlaying -> Escape returns to Search route, but focus lands on different station than opened result.
Search recent -> RadioPlaying -> keyCode4 return does not restore focus to originating recent card.
Favorites deep row fixture (35) -> RadioPlaying -> Escape returns to Favorites route, but focused station ID is not the original deep-row station.
When country selector is open, first Escape is expected to close modal and stay on RadioPlaying, but flow navigates away to Discover in direct-entry path.

integration_issues.flow: Live stream playback while testing back-navigation
integration_issues.issue: Frequent third-party stream/CORS/network failures (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, 402/404/502, SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED) create noisy retries during UI flow validation.

action_items: Fix source-station focus restoration in Discover/GenreList/Search/Favorites so returned focus stationID equals originally opened stationID (not neighbor/last focused card).
In RadioPlaying country-selector-open key path, consume back key fully (preventDefault + stopPropagation and avoid duplicate listeners) so first back only closes modal.
Re-run full back-flow matrix (mouse + D-pad Enter open, Escape/Backspace/461/10009/4 back) including deep pagination cases and verify stationID-focused assertions.
Optional hardening: reduce external stream/logo error noise to keep console signal clean during navigation QA.
critical_code_review_comments: Likely RCA for modal-back bug: country-selector-open branch in RadioPlaying handles close but does not stopPropagation; parallel key listeners can process same event as page back.

Focus restore currently depends on matching [data-station-id] + optional data-nav-section; dynamic lists reorder/refresh and can produce wrong target resolution when section arrays mutate after return.

success_rate.frontend: 68% (routing regressions pass; multiple return-focus flows + modal-back ordering fail)

seed_data_creation: Browser localStorage only: selectedCountry=Türkiye + selectedCountryCode=TR + 35-item mega_radio_favorites fixture using live station IDs. No real account/API mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Required source suites passed: regression_issue54_behavior (41 assertions), regression_iteration57_reveal_tv_layout (5 assertions). New helper suite passed: regression_iteration59_navigation_helpers (14 assertions). Live direct route checks confirmed: #/radio-playing?station=<id> canonicalizes to ?station=<id>#/radio-playing; same-route query update changes station param; #/search?q=jazz loads Search page.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction examples: (1) Open deep GenreList station (index>=30) -> RadioPlaying -> Backspace => returns GenreList but active/focused station differs from source stationID. (2) Open Search result/recent -> RadioPlaying -> Escape/keyCode4 => returns Search but focus points to different stationID. (3) Open RadioPlaying country selector -> press Escape once => expected stay on RadioPlaying; observed navigation away to Discover in direct-entry path. Mitigation: route-scoped single back handler, consume back event in modal state, and restore focus by stable stationID lookup after list hydration with strict section+ID matching and deferred focus only when target exists.
